source_roles.tushare: published research fallback and independent reconciliation source
source_roles.bigqmt: broker-consistent cache, real-time and incremental candidate source

canonical_fields.open: CNY per share/unit, raw unless adjustment_mode says otherwise
canonical_fields.volume_lots: hands/lots; BigQMT prohibited until measured against reference sources
canonical_fields.amount_yuan: CNY; BigQMT prohibited until measured against reference sources
canonical_fields.adjustment_mode: none/front/back; PIT is a separately derived layer
canonical_fields.source_release: immutable source or cache snapshot identity

cleaning_rules.exact_duplicate: retain one row only when normalized payload hashes are identical; otherwise quarantine
cleaning_rules.missing_values: preserve as null with reason; never forward-fill OHLCV or amount
cleaning_rules.invalid_ohlc: quarantine; never clip or manufacture prices
cleaning_rules.numeric_representation: parse decimal values before canonical serialization

adjustment_and_pit_rules.raw_layer: stores unadjusted BigQMT bars with adjustment_mode=none only
adjustment_and_pit_rules.factor_source: reuse the shared-lake canonical factor/corporate-action chain; never infer factors from BigQMT front/back bars
adjustment_and_pit_rules.pit_generation: derive PIT separately after raw release validation; require available_at and source_version

decision_rules.matching_published_key: record provenance and reconciliation only; do not duplicate the bar
decision_rules.missing_published_key: write BigQMT row only to candidate overlay; publish after all gates pass
decision_rules.conflicting_published_key: quarantine with row-level comparison; do not overwrite
decision_rules.latest_pointer: never update from a BigQMT candidate run
